_note: Question-specific Economics explanations for official-key-only placeholders. Exact stem and keyed answer guards prevent stale application. Official-key disputes are documented separately; an explanation does not change a key.

mpsc-group-b-ng-2024-paper-1-a-q021.expectedStem: Which Indian state has the highest GDP during 2023-24?
mpsc-group-b-ng-2024-paper-1-a-q021.explanation: For 2023–24, Maharashtra had the largest state gross domestic product among the listed states. State GDP measures production within a state; this is a reference-year ranking, not a permanent rank.

mpsc-group-b-ng-2024-paper-1-a-q042.expectedStem: The amount of money allocated for capital expenditure (CAPEX) in the Indian Budget 2024-25 is-
mpsc-group-b-ng-2024-paper-1-a-q042.explanation: The Interim Union Budget for 2024–25 budgeted ₹11,11,111 crore for capital expenditure. CAPEX funds asset creation such as infrastructure; the precise amount belongs to that budget estimate.

mpsc-group-b-ng-2024-paper-1-a-q045.expectedStem: To control inflation in the economy, RBI-
mpsc-group-b-ng-2024-paper-1-a-q045.explanation: Selling government securities in open market operations withdraws money from banks and the public. Lower liquidity and credit growth can help restrain demand-driven inflation; buying securities or cutting policy rates would generally ease money conditions.

mpsc-group-b-aao-2024-gk-Q37.expectedStem: Per Capita Income of a country is obtained by dividing National Income by which of the following?
mpsc-group-b-aao-2024-gk-Q37.explanation: Per capita income is national income divided by the whole population. Dividing only by workers would measure income per worker, a different statistic.

mpsc-group-b-aao-2024-gk-Q74.expectedStem: About 6% of the country’s GDP is contributed by Indian diaspora. Which country is this?
mpsc-group-b-aao-2024-gk-Q74.explanation: The paper’s 6% figure refers to Indian-origin people’s estimated economic contribution in the United Kingdom. It is a source-specific estimate about diaspora contribution, not a component of India’s own GDP.

mpsc-group-b-aao-2024-gk-Q85.expectedStem: Which one of the following situation can lead to inflation?
mpsc-group-b-aao-2024-gk-Q85.explanation: Inflation can arise when aggregate spending rises faster than the economy can supply goods and services. This demand-pull pressure raises the general price level.

mpsc-group-b-aao-2024-gk-Q97.expectedStem: RBI has increased the UPI payment limit from ₹1.00 lakh to how much?
mpsc-group-b-aao-2024-gk-Q97.explanation: The ₹5 lakh UPI ceiling applied to specified categories, including payments to hospitals and educational institutions (and later tax payments). Ordinary UPI transfers generally retained a lower standard cap; the question omits that qualification.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2025-gs2-Q.expectedStem: Consider the following statements: (i)Harrod – Domar model was adopted in 1st Five Year Plan. (ii)Nehru – Mahalanobis model was adopted in 2nd Five Year Plan. (iii)Gadgil model was adopted in 5th Five Year Plan. (iv)Rao-Manmohan Singh model was adopted in 8th Five Year Plan. Which of the statements given above are correct?
mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2025-gs2-Q.explanation: The First Plan drew on Harrod–Domar growth ideas, the Second on the Mahalanobis heavy-industry strategy, and the Eighth followed the Rao–Manmohan Singh liberalisation framework. The Gadgil approach does not correctly describe the Fifth Plan in this list, leaving (i), (ii) and (iv).

mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2025-gs2-Q.expectedStem: Consider the following agricultural related revolutions in India: (i)Green revolution – Agriculture (HYV) production (ii)Yellow revolution – Oilseeds production (iii)Round revolution – Potato production (iv)Protein revolution – High agricultural production Which of the revolutions given above are correct?
mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2025-gs2-Q.explanation: Green denotes higher farm output using high-yielding varieties, yellow denotes oilseeds, and round denotes potatoes. The paper also uses “protein revolution” for raising agricultural output; under its terminology all four pairings are accepted.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2025-gs2-Q.expectedStem: What fiscal policy response did the Government of India undertake in recent times in response to the aggravated global supply disruptions? (i)Decreasing food and fertilizers subsidies. (ii)Increasing taxes on fuel and imported products. (iii)Reducing taxes on fuel and certain imported products. Select the correct answer from the codes given below:
mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2025-gs2-Q.explanation: The response described is a cut in fuel taxes and duties on selected imports. Lowering these levies can reduce the domestic cost of disrupted supply; raising them would add to prices.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2025-gs2-Q.expectedStem: Fiscal policy in India comprises of the following components: (i)Government receipts (ii)Government expenditure (iii)Public debt Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2025-gs2-Q.explanation: Fiscal policy concerns the government budget: receipts, expenditure and borrowing or public debt. Each of the three listed components therefore belongs to fiscal policy.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2025-gs2-Q.expectedStem: The growth of India’s real GDP during the year 2024 – 2025 is estimated at
mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2025-gs2-Q.explanation: The paper’s 6.5% figure is an estimate for real GDP growth in FY 2024–25. Such advance estimates can differ from later revised national accounts, so the percentage should be read with its forecast date.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2025-gs2-Q.expectedStem: Who was the first Chairman of Planning Commission of India?
mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2025-gs2-Q.explanation: Jawaharlal Nehru chaired the Planning Commission at its creation in 1950 as Prime Minister. Mahalanobis helped shape the Second Plan but was not its first chair.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2025-gs2-Q.expectedStem: The main objectives of NITI Aayog are: (i)Cooperative federalism. (ii)Formulation of plans at village level. (iii)Economic policy that incorporates national security interests (iv)Innovation and entrepreneurial support. Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2025-gs2-Q.explanation: NITI Aayog was set up to support cooperative federalism, planning inputs from village level, policy that accounts for national security, and innovation. Thus all four listed objectives fit its institutional mandate.

mpsc-group-b-cdpo-2025-gs-Q5.expectedStem: The new GST rate structure in India after September 2025 is:
mpsc-group-b-cdpo-2025-gs-Q5.explanation: The September 2025 GST changes set main rates of 5% and 18%, with a special 40% rate for selected luxury and demerit goods. The former 12% and 28% main slabs were rationalised; the new rates took effect from 22 September 2025 for most items.

mpsc-group-b-cdpo-2025-gs-Q25.expectedStem: The Human Development Index (HDI) was developed by:
mpsc-group-b-cdpo-2025-gs-Q25.explanation: Mahbub ul Haq developed the Human Development Index for UNDP, with important intellectual input from Amartya Sen. The index broadens development beyond income alone.

mpsc-group-b-cdpo-2025-gs-Q30.expectedStem: The concept of “trickle-down effect” in economic development refers to:
mpsc-group-b-cdpo-2025-gs-Q30.explanation: “Trickle down” is the claim that benefits from overall growth eventually reach poorer households through jobs, incomes or other channels. It does not by itself mean direct tax redistribution or subsidy.

mpsc-group-b-cdpo-2025-gs-Q70.expectedStem: The major objectives of NITI Aayog are to-
mpsc-group-b-cdpo-2025-gs-Q70.explanation: NITI Aayog provides policy and technical advice and develops strategic, long-term programmes. Both listed functions are therefore within its advisory and planning role.

mpsc-group-b-cdpo-2025-gs-Q72.expectedStem: Which of the following best explains the theoretical foundation of the design of the Mahatma Gandhi Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MNREGA)?
mpsc-group-b-cdpo-2025-gs-Q72.explanation: MGNREGA guarantees paid rural work and supports household demand when private employment is weak. That demand-support mechanism is closest to a Keynesian rural stimulus among the choices.

mpsc-group-b-adtp-2026-gs-Q54.expectedStem: The belief that economic growth will trickle down to all sectors is known as
mpsc-group-b-adtp-2026-gs-Q54.explanation: Trickle-down theory holds that gains from aggregate growth will spread across sectors and income groups over time. The question directly names that belief.

mpsc-group-b-adtp-2026-gs-Q60.expectedStem: In India, National Income is computed by
mpsc-group-b-adtp-2026-gs-Q60.explanation: India’s national accounts and national-income estimates are prepared by the National Statistical Office within the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation.

mpsc-group-b-agri-2025-gs-Q8.expectedStem: The new GST rate for luxury items and ‘sin’ goods is:
mpsc-group-b-agri-2025-gs-Q8.explanation: The September 2025 GST reform introduced a special 40% demerit rate for selected luxury and “sin” goods, alongside the main 5% and 18% slabs. Treatment and commencement for some tobacco items were separately deferred.

mpsc-group-b-agri-2025-gs-Q51.expectedStem: Regarding ‘Goods and Services Tax (GST)’: I.It is a destination-based tax. II.It has subsumed all indirect taxes including Basic Customs Duty. III.The GST Council is a constitutional body chaired by the Union Finance Minister. Which of the statements is/are correct?
mpsc-group-b-agri-2025-gs-Q51.explanation: GST is levied on consumption at the destination, and the GST Council is a constitutional body chaired by the Union Finance Minister. Basic Customs Duty remains outside GST, so statements I and III alone are true.

mpsc-group-b-agri-2025-gs-Q53.expectedStem: The ‘Human Development Index (HDI)’ comprises which of the following dimensions? 1.Long and healthy life2.Access to knowledge 3.Decent standard of living4.Political freedom Select the correct option:
mpsc-group-b-agri-2025-gs-Q53.explanation: HDI combines life expectancy (health), education (knowledge), and gross national income per person (living standard). Political freedom is valuable but is not one of its three measured dimensions.

mpsc-group-b-mcs-prelim-2025-p1-Q13.expectedStem: Which district in Mizoram ranked highest in NITI Aayog second edition of the North Eastern Region District SDG Index 2023-24?
mpsc-group-b-mcs-prelim-2025-p1-Q13.explanation: The NITI Aayog North Eastern Region District SDG Index 2023–24 ranks Hnahthial first in Mizoram and first across the northeastern districts, with a composite score of 81.43. This is specific to that index edition.

mpsc-group-b-mcs-prelim-2025-p1-Q58.expectedStem: In the context of the Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) monetary policy operations, a sustained period of increasing Repo Rate is generally expected to have which of the following effects on the Indian economy? (i)Dampen demand-pull inflation by increasing the cost of borrowing and investment. (ii)Reduce the net interest margin (NIM) of commercial banks that rely heavily on deposits for funding. (iii)Lead to an appreciation of the Indian Rupee against major global currencies. (iv)Encourage a shift in household savings from market-linked instruments to bank fixed deposits. Select the correct answer using the code given below:
mpsc-group-b-mcs-prelim-2025-p1-Q58.explanation: Higher repo rates normally raise borrowing costs, cooling demand-driven inflation; they can also make rupee assets more attractive and bank deposits relatively appealing. A fall in banks’ net interest margins is not a general consequence because margins depend on how loan and deposit rates adjust.

mpsc-group-b-mcs-prelim-2025-p1-Q59.expectedStem: Consider the following potential effects on economic development when the central bank decides to lower the Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) in a developing economy: (i)It is likely to inject additional liquidity into the banking system, potentially increasing banks’ capacity for credit creation. (ii)It could lead to a reduction in market interest rates, making borrowing cheaper for businesses and consumers. (iii)It might stimulate aggregate demand, potentially leading to increased investment and consumption. (iv)It invariably guarantees a rapid acceleration of real economic growth by ensuring optimal allocation of credit to productive sectors. Which of the statements given above are conceptually sound effects of lowering CRR, but not necessarily a guaranteed outcome in all economic contexts?
mpsc-group-b-mcs-prelim-2025-p1-Q59.explanation: A lower CRR releases reserves, potentially allowing more bank lending, lower rates and stronger spending. It cannot guarantee real growth, since banks may not lend or credit may be unproductive. Thus (i), (ii) and (iii) are possible effects, while (iv) overclaims.

mpsc-group-b-radio-2026-p2-Q46.expectedStem: The NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India) was formed in 2015, replacing which institution?
mpsc-group-b-radio-2026-p2-Q46.explanation: NITI Aayog was established in 2015 as the successor to the Planning Commission. The Finance Commission and other listed bodies have different constitutional or coordinating roles.

mpsc-group-b-acm-2026-gs-Q52.expectedStem: In India, poverty ratio is lowest in:
mpsc-group-b-acm-2026-gs-Q52.explanation: Kerala is the intended choice among these states and Union Territory in the poverty comparison used by the paper. Poverty rankings depend on whether the measure is consumption poverty or a multidimensional index and on the reference year.

mpsc-group-b-acm-2026-gs-Q53.expectedStem: With reference to multidimensional poverty, consider the following statements: 1.It goes beyond income-based measurement. 2.It includes health and education indicators. 3.It is measured exclusively by GDP growth. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mpsc-group-b-acm-2026-gs-Q53.explanation: Multidimensional poverty measures deprivations beyond income, including health and education. GDP growth alone does not measure whether households lack these essentials, so statements 1 and 2 are correct.

mpsc-group-b-acm-2026-gs-Q58.expectedStem: With reference to inequality, consider the following statements: 1.High economic growth automatically reduces inequality. 2.Inequality can coexist with poverty reduction. 3.Excessive inequality can hinder long-term growth. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mpsc-group-b-acm-2026-gs-Q58.explanation: Growth need not automatically narrow inequality. Poor households can become better off while the gap to richer households widens; severe inequality can also undermine human capital and long-run growth. Thus 2 and 3 are correct.

mpsc-group-b-ceo-2025-gk-Q30.expectedStem: Which of the following are considered Capital Expenditure? 1.Purchase of land2.Purchase of machinery 3.Investment in shares4.Salaries of employees
mpsc-group-b-ceo-2025-gk-Q30.explanation: Land, machinery and equity investments acquire assets or financial claims, so they are capital expenditure. Salaries pay for current operations and are revenue expenditure.

mpsc-group-b-ceo-2025-gk-Q32.expectedStem: Which of the following is included in the calculation of a country’s Gross Domestic Product (GDP)?
mpsc-group-b-ceo-2025-gk-Q32.explanation: GDP is the market value of final goods and services produced within a country during a period. Counting raw inputs separately would double count them; production by citizens abroad belongs in national, not domestic, aggregates.

mpsc-group-b-ceo-2025-gk-Q33.expectedStem: Consider the following statements about the Indian economy: 1.Share of services in GDP significantly increased 2.Share of India’s exports in world trade increased 3.FDI inflows decreased Which of the following occurred in India after the economic liberalization in 1991?
mpsc-group-b-ceo-2025-gk-Q33.explanation: After 1991 liberalisation, services gained a larger share of GDP and India’s share of global trade rose. FDI inflows did not generally decline as statement 3 suggests, leaving statements 1 and 2.

mpsc-group-b-ceo-2025-gk-Q34.expectedStem: Which of the following best defines ‘inflation’ in an economy?
mpsc-group-b-ceo-2025-gk-Q34.explanation: Inflation is a sustained rise in the overall price level. It is broader than one temporary food-price shock and means each unit of money buys less on average.

mpsc-group-b-ceo-2025-gk-Q78.expectedStem: The WTO replaced which earlier organization?
mpsc-group-b-ceo-2025-gk-Q78.explanation: The World Trade Organization began in 1995 and succeeded the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade framework, adding a more formal institution and wider trade agreements.

mpsc-group-b-ceo-2025-gk-Q80.expectedStem: Which of the following is a monetary policy tool of RBI?
mpsc-group-b-ceo-2025-gk-Q80.explanation: The Cash Reserve Ratio is set by RBI and changes how much of banks’ deposits must be held as reserves. Income tax, GST and the Union Budget are fiscal instruments.

mpsc-group-b-ceo-2025-gk-Q83.expectedStem: ‘Repo Rate’ is the rate at which:
mpsc-group-b-ceo-2025-gk-Q83.explanation: The repo rate is the rate at which RBI lends short-term funds to banks against eligible securities. It is a policy rate used to influence wider borrowing costs.

mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs1-Q94.expectedStem: Consider the following statements: (i)President of India has given assent to the Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) (VB -G RAM G) Bill, 2025 marking a significant milestone in the transformation of rural employment policy. (ii)The Viksit Bharat - G RAM G Act, 2025 replaces MGNREGA. The Bill was introduced in Lok Sabha on December 16, 2025 and was passed, two days later, on December 18, 2025. In Rajya Sabha, it was passed on December 19, 2025. (iii)The employment guarantee is enhanced to 125 days per rural household, strengthening income security; but not shifted from Demand-Based Model to Normative Allocation Framework. Which of the statements given above is/are wrong?
mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs1-Q94.explanation: Statement (iii) is false: the VB–G RAM G Act raised the rural wage-employment guarantee to 125 days per eligible household and adopted a normative allocation framework for states. The President assented in December 2025; the provisions came into force on 1 July 2026. Thus “not shifted” makes (iii) the wrong statement.

mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q43.expectedStem: Match the economic terms in Column I with their correct definitions in Column II: Column I (Economic Column II (Definitions) **Terms)** 1. Short-term measures to control inflation and correct A. Structural Reform **the balance of payments.** 2. Selling off part of the equity of Public Sector B. Stabilisation Measures **Enterprises to the public.** 3. Long-term measures to improve the efficiency of the C. Disinvestment **economy and international competitiveness.** 4. Reduction in the value of domestic currency vis-à-vis D. Devaluation **foreign currency by the government.** Select the correct option from the codes given below:
mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q43.explanation: Stabilisation measures address short-run inflation and external imbalance (1); structural reforms improve long-run efficiency (3); disinvestment sells public-enterprise equity (2); devaluation lowers the official foreign-currency value of domestic currency (4). Hence A-3, B-1, C-2, D-4.

mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q45.expectedStem: Identify the correct chronological order of the following events in the Indian Economy: 1.Establishment of the Planning Commission. 2.Nationalisation of Commercial Banks. 3.Introduction of New Economic Policy (LPG). 4.Setting up of NITI Aayog.
mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q45.explanation: The Planning Commission was set up in 1950; major commercial-bank nationalisation occurred in 1969; the New Economic Policy began in 1991; and NITI Aayog began in 2015. This gives 1-2-3-4.

mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q47.expectedStem: With reference to Poverty Estimation in India, the Planning Commission accepted the calorie norm of:
mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q47.explanation: The older Planning Commission poverty-line method used 2,400 calories per person per day in rural areas and 2,100 in urban areas, reflecting different work and consumption patterns. Later poverty methods changed.

mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q52.expectedStem: Which of the following is a direct tax?
mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q52.explanation: Corporation tax is imposed directly on a company’s taxable income. GST, excise and customs duties are indirect taxes collected on transactions or goods.

mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q55.expectedStem: Assertion (A ):The service sector in India has grown rapidly in terms of contribution to GDP but
mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q55.explanation: The intended assertion is that services grew strongly in GDP without proportional employment growth. Many service activities are relatively skill intensive or capital intensive, so they absorb fewer workers per unit of output than their GDP share might imply; the OCR text of the reason is damaged.

mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q56.expectedStem: Who among the following is known as the ‘Architect of Indian Planning’ for his contribution to the Second Five Year Plan strategy?
mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q56.explanation: P. C. Mahalanobis designed the Second Five Year Plan’s emphasis on heavy industry and capital goods, giving him the planning epithet in the question.

mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q58.expectedStem: What is the primary function of the ‘Reserve Bank of India (RBI)’?
mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q58.explanation: RBI is the central bank: it issues banknotes and manages monetary conditions, including money and credit. Tax collection and securities-market regulation belong to other bodies.

mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q60.expectedStem: Which of the following correctly defines ‘Fiscal Policy’?
mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q60.explanation: Fiscal policy uses government taxation, spending and borrowing to influence the economy. Policy rates and money supply belong to monetary policy.

mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q70.expectedStem: Minimum Support Price (MSP) is announced to:
mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q70.explanation: A minimum support price is intended as a price floor for eligible crops, protecting farmers from a sharp fall in market prices and supporting income certainty.

mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q71.explanation: Capital expenditure generally creates a durable asset or reduces a liability, for example building infrastructure or buying machinery. It is distinct from routine consumption spending.

mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q72.explanation: Expansionary fiscal policy raises aggregate demand through higher government spending and/or lower taxes, often at the cost of a larger near-term deficit.

mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q74.expectedStem: The main objective of monetary policy is to:
mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q74.explanation: The central purpose of monetary policy is price stability while supporting growth. RBI uses policy rates and liquidity tools to influence inflation.

mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q75.expectedStem: Repo rate refers to the rate at which?
mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q75.explanation: Repo is the short-term rate for RBI lending to banks against securities. A bank depositing funds with RBI would instead face the reverse-repo or deposit-facility rate.

mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q77.explanation: SEBI oversees India’s securities and capital markets, including intermediaries and investor protection. RBI and IRDAI have the principal banking and insurance roles.

mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q80.expectedStem: The Mahalanobis strategy of planning emphasized:
mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs2-Q80.explanation: The Mahalanobis Second Plan prioritised basic and heavy industries, especially capital goods, to expand future productive capacity.

mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs3-Q3.expectedStem: Which institution played a key role in India’s Green Revolution through scientific research?
mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs3-Q3.explanation: The Indian Agricultural Research Institute contributed crop research and high-yielding wheat development central to the Green Revolution. ICAR is the wider coordinating research council, making the institute the intended specific choice.

mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs3-Q12.expectedStem: Which statement best captures the institutional division of roles between MeitY, DST, and NITI Aayog regarding India’s AI ecosystem as of 2024–2025?
mpsc-group-b-cao-2026-gs3-Q12.explanation: For the 2024–25 AI ecosystem, MeitY led the IndiaAI compute and implementation agenda, DST supported foundational science research, and NITI Aayog supplied cross-government strategy. The other choices assign the institutions roles they did not have.

mpsc-group-b-lecturer-serchhip-2026-gs-Q.expectedStem: Which of the following best distinguishes NPCI from RBI?
mpsc-group-b-lecturer-serchhip-2026-gs-Q.explanation: NPCI operates retail payment infrastructure such as UPI. RBI is the central bank that regulates payments and monetary conditions; it does not itself run ordinary payment apps.

mpsc-group-b-lecturer-serchhip-2026-gs-Q.expectedStem: Consider the following statements regarding cooperative federalism in India: 1.It requires constitutionally equal tax powers 2.It encourages centre–state policy coordination 3.GST Council is an example Which statement(s) is/are correct?
mpsc-group-b-lecturer-serchhip-2026-gs-Q.explanation: Cooperative federalism involves Union–state coordination, illustrated by the GST Council. It does not require identical constitutional taxation powers, so only statements 2 and 3 hold.

mpsc-group-b-lecturer-serchhip-2026-gs-Q.expectedStem: Finance Commission recommends on: 1.Tax devolution 2.Grants-in-aid 3.Monetary policy Which are correct?
mpsc-group-b-lecturer-serchhip-2026-gs-Q.explanation: The Finance Commission recommends tax sharing between Union and states and grants-in-aid. Monetary policy is RBI’s responsibility, so only 1 and 2 apply.
When RBI changes the repo rate, banks’ funding costs and lending-rate benchmarks can change, directly affecting loan interest rates.

mpsc-group-b-lecturer-serchhip-2026-gs-Q.expectedStem: Which of the following increases Current Account Deficit (CAD)?
mpsc-group-b-lecturer-serchhip-2026-gs-Q.explanation: More crude-oil imports raise payments to the rest of the world and can widen the current-account deficit. Software exports, remittances and fewer gold imports tend to improve it.

mpsc-group-b-mes-combined-2025-gs-Q38.expectedStem: As per the new income tax rates for FY 2025-26 in the Union Budget 2025, what is the income tax rate for a person earning more than Rs. 24 lakhs per annum?
mpsc-group-b-mes-combined-2025-gs-Q38.explanation: Under the FY 2025–26 new-regime income-tax schedule, taxable income above ₹24 lakh falls in the 30% marginal slab. That is the rate on income in the slab, not necessarily the effective rate on all income.

mpsc-group-b-mes-combined-2025-gs-Q60.expectedStem: How is India’s Gross Domestic Product (GDP) calculated?
mpsc-group-b-mes-combined-2025-gs-Q60.explanation: GDP can be compiled from value added by industries (the production approach) and from final spending on consumption, investment, government purchases and net exports (the expenditure approach). CPI measures prices, not total output.

mpsc-group-b-mes-combined-2025-gs-Q61.expectedStem: Which of the following institutions formulates the monetary policy in India?
mpsc-group-b-mes-combined-2025-gs-Q61.explanation: RBI conducts monetary policy through its Monetary Policy Committee and related instruments. NITI Aayog and the Finance Ministry have different policy roles.

mpsc-group-b-mes-combined-2025-gs-Q71.expectedStem: The Reserve Bank of India was nationalized in:
mpsc-group-b-mes-combined-2025-gs-Q71.explanation: RBI began operations in 1935 and was nationalised in 1949. Its founding date is therefore earlier than its nationalisation.

mpsc-group-b-mes-combined-2025-gs-Q84.expectedStem: Who is called the Father of the Green Revolution in India?
mpsc-group-b-mes-combined-2025-gs-Q84.explanation: M. S. Swaminathan is called the father of India’s Green Revolution for his role in adapting and advancing high-yielding crop technology in India. Norman Borlaug is associated with the global Green Revolution.

mpsc-group-b-mes-combined-2025-gs-Q88.expectedStem: The ‘Blue Revolution’ in India is associated with:
mpsc-group-b-mes-combined-2025-gs-Q88.explanation: The Blue Revolution refers to growth in fisheries and aquaculture production. Dairy growth is called the White Revolution.

mpsc-group-b-mes-combined-2025-gs-Q97.expectedStem: In which year was the Goods and Services Tax (GST) launched in India?

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.explanation: GST is a destination-based value-added tax: tax is charged along the supply chain with input-tax credits, so the burden is intended to fall on final consumption.
