mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.explanation: The First Five Year Plan started in 1951 and covered 1951–56. Planning Commission establishment in 1950 was preparatory, not the plan’s start.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.expectedStem: Planning Commission was scrapped on
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.explanation: The government announced in 2014 that the Planning Commission would be replaced; NITI Aayog was constituted on 1 January 2015. The key uses the 2014 announcement as the “scrapped” date.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.expectedStem: Niti Aayog came into effect on
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.explanation: NITI Aayog was established by a Union Cabinet resolution effective 1 January 2015, taking over the planning-policy role of the former Planning Commission.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.expectedStem: Identify the correct sequence of components within the Balance of Payments (BoP) statement. A. Current Account B. Capital Account C. Financial Account D. Errors and Omissions Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.explanation: A standard balance-of-payments presentation lists the current account, capital account, financial account, and then errors and omissions to reconcile the accounts. That yields A-B-C-D.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.expectedStem: Gross National Product (GNP) can be calculated as
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.explanation: GNP equals GDP plus net factor income from abroad: domestic production plus residents’ net earnings from overseas. Depreciation subtracted from GDP gives net domestic product, not GNP. The first option is truncated by OCR, so its exact wording needs restoration.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.expectedStem: When was the International Monetary Fund (IMF) set up?
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.explanation: The Bretton Woods conference that established the design of the IMF took place in 1944, the keyed year. The Fund legally came into existence in 1945, so “set up” should be read as the 1944 founding agreement.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.expectedStem: Goods and Services Tax Council (GST) of India is headed by
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.explanation: Article 279A provides for the GST Council, with the Union Finance Minister as chairperson and state finance or taxation ministers as members.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.expectedStem: In India, the Good and Services Tax (GST) came into effect on
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.explanation: GST commenced in India on 1 July 2017. The “1%” symbols in the options are scanning errors for “1st.”

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.expectedStem: Which amongst the following was the first State to approve Goods and Services Tax (GST) bill in India?
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.explanation: Assam was the first Indian state to ratify the Constitution Amendment Bill enabling GST, in August 2016. Ratification of that bill preceded GST’s July 2017 start.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.expectedStem: The rate at which the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) gives loans to the Commercial Banks is called
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.explanation: The key chooses Bank Rate, a traditional RBI lending or rediscount rate used in credit policy. For modern short-term collateralised RBI loans to banks, the more precise term is repo rate; the unqualified wording makes these choices ambiguous.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.expectedStem: The percentage of total deposits that commercial banks are required to keep with the Reserve Bank of India in the form of cash is called
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.explanation: The Cash Reserve Ratio is the share of a bank’s net demand and time liabilities it must hold as cash balance with RBI. SLR is a separate requirement for liquid assets.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.expectedStem: Increased in Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) by the Reserve Bank of India indicates that
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.explanation: A higher CRR locks up a larger share of banks’ deposits at RBI. That leaves less lendable funding and tends to restrain credit expansion.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.expectedStem: The Monetary Policy Framework of India is formulated by
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.explanation: RBI conducts India’s monetary policy under the RBI Act and the monetary-policy framework. The Monetary Policy Committee sets the policy repo rate within this framework.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.expectedStem: The primary objective of monetary policy is
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.explanation: The RBI Act’s monetary-policy objective is to maintain price stability while keeping in mind the objective of growth. Printing currency is a central-bank function, not the stated primary policy objective.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.expectedStem: The Reserve Bank of India is vested with the responsibility of conducting monetary policy. This responsibility is explicitly mandated under the
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 gives RBI its statutory basis. The amended Act provides the modern monetary-policy framework and Monetary Policy Committee.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.expectedStem: As per the Union Budget 2023-24, the government aimed to bring down the fiscal deficit from 6.4 per cent of GDP (2022-23) to
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.explanation: The 2023–24 Union Budget targeted a fiscal deficit of 5.9% of GDP, down from the 2022–23 revised estimate of 6.4%. This refers to that budget estimate.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.expectedStem: Which Committee was set up to review the concept of Poverty Line?
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.explanation: The Suresh Tendulkar Committee reviewed poverty estimation and recommended a revised consumption-based methodology that moved beyond a direct calorie cutoff.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.expectedStem: Which is not one of the 7 Pillars of effective governance envisaged by NITI Aayog?
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-inpector-of-sup.explanation: The source key excludes “Efficiency,” but efficiency is widely treated as a good-governance principle. The stem does not identify a verifiable seven-pillar NITI Aayog framework, so this exclusion needs a primary-source citation before it can be explained as a rule.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-group-b-combine.expectedStem: The slogan of which Five-Year Plan in India is “Faster, More inclusive and Sustainable Growth”?
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-group-b-combine.explanation: “Faster, More Inclusive and Sustainable Growth” was the theme of India’s Twelfth Five Year Plan (2012–17). The Eleventh Plan used “Faster and More Inclusive Growth.”

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-group-b-combine.expectedStem: Reserve Bank of India was established on -
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-group-b-combine.explanation: RBI began operations on 1 April 1935 under the RBI Act, 1934. Nationalisation came later, in 1949.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-group-b-combine.expectedStem: Who first estimated the National Income in India?
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-group-b-combine.explanation: Dadabhai Naoroji made the earliest widely cited estimate of India’s national income in the nineteenth century, as part of his analysis of colonial economic conditions.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-group-b-combine.expectedStem: ‘Base year ’ in National Income accounting means -
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-group-b-combine.explanation: A base year fixes the prices used to value output when calculating real GDP. Holding prices constant lets the measure isolate changes in production volume.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-group-b-combine.expectedStem: Which sector makes the largest contributions to India’s GDP?
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-group-b-combine.explanation: The tertiary or services sector is the largest contributor to India’s GDP among the broad primary, secondary and tertiary sectors.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-group-b-combine.expectedStem: Who is called “the Father of the Green Revolution’ in India?
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-group-b-combine.explanation: M. S. Swaminathan is known as the father of the Green Revolution in India for his scientific leadership in introducing high-yielding crop varieties and related practices.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-group-b-combine.expectedStem: The slogan “Garibi Hatao” was introduced in which Five-Year Plan?
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-group-b-combine.explanation: “Garibi Hatao” (“remove poverty”) became a prominent slogan in the era of the Fifth Five Year Plan (1974–79), which placed poverty removal among its main objectives.

mpsc-group-b-ng-april-2026-assistant-les.explanation: HDI assesses a long and healthy life, education and a decent standard of living. Income or education alone covers only one dimension.

mpsc-group-b-ng-april-2026-assistant-les.expectedStem: Poverty line is determined based on:
mpsc-group-b-ng-april-2026-assistant-les.explanation: Traditional Indian poverty-line estimates used household consumption expenditure to judge whether minimum consumption needs could be met. Income is harder to measure consistently in the underlying surveys.

mpsc-group-b-ng-april-2026-assistant-les.expectedStem: What GDP growth rate has ICRA projected for India in Q3 FY 2025-2026?
mpsc-group-b-ng-april-2026-assistant-les.explanation: The keyed 7.2% is the upper end of ICRA’s 7.1–7.2% forecast for India’s Q3 FY 2025–26 real GDP growth at constant 2011–12 prices. It is a forecast from that release, not the subsequently published official GDP growth estimate.

mpsc-udc-artculture-2016-paper-2-q032.expectedStem: Writer of the book, “Who moved my interest rate”
mpsc-udc-artculture-2016-paper-2-q032.explanation: 'Who Moved My Interest Rate?' is a memoir by former RBI Governor D. Subbarao. The title refers to his account of monetary-policy decisions while leading the Reserve Bank of India.

mpsc-udc-excise-2018-paper-2-q032.expectedStem: What is the full form of PPP?
mpsc-udc-excise-2018-paper-2-q032.explanation: In this general/administrative usage, PPP stands for Public Private Partnership. Here PPP names a collaboration between the government and private businesses to finance or provide a public service; the similarly worded alternatives are not standard expansions.

mpsc-udc-arc-2020-paper-2-q046.expectedStem: What is the full form of PPP?
mpsc-udc-arc-2020-paper-2-q046.explanation: PPP commonly stands for Public Private Partnership. The term describes a government–private-sector arrangement for delivering infrastructure or services; “Purchasing Power Point” is not the economics term purchasing power parity.

mpsc-udc-taxation-2021-paper-2-q030.expectedStem: The organization that released ‘The Future of Jobs Report 2020’ is
mpsc-udc-taxation-2021-paper-2-q030.explanation: The World Economic Forum released 'The Future of Jobs Report 2020'. It is the WEF publication on employment trends and future skills, rather than a report issued by the ILO, WTO or UN.

mpsc-udc-agriculture-2018-paper-2-q059.explanation: VAT is the standard abbreviation for Value Added Tax. The tax applies to the value added at each production or distribution stage, with input tax credit preventing repeated taxation of the same value.

mpsc-udc-tourism-2018-paper-2-q049.explanation: ATM stands for Automated Teller Machine. A teller machine lets customers perform common banking transactions such as withdrawals without a human bank teller.

mpsc-asst-2014-paper-2-q019.expectedStem: Literacy rate is lowest in the state of
mpsc-asst-2014-paper-2-q019.explanation: Bihar had the lowest literacy rate in India in the 2011 census, at about 61.8 per cent. This compares the four listed states using the 2011 Census, the reference available when this 2014 paper was set; later literacy estimates are a different time series.

mpsc-group-b-ng-technical-2024-gk-q051.expectedStem: Which of the following Five Year Plan was implemented with the slogan "Garibi Hatao"?
mpsc-group-b-ng-technical-2024-gk-q051.explanation: The Fifth Plan (1974–79) adopted poverty removal as a central aim; the slogan “Garibi Hatao” identifies that plan among the four choices.

mpsc-group-b-ng-technical-2024-gk-q055.expectedStem: Which Five Year Plan had the primary goal to establish India as self-reliant and self-generating economy?
mpsc-group-b-ng-technical-2024-gk-q055.explanation: The Third Plan (1961–66) sought a self-reliant, self-generating economy; the First Plan focused more on agriculture and the Second on heavy industry.

mpsc-group-b-jao-2025-p2-Q25.expectedStem: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) was established on:
mpsc-group-b-jao-2025-p2-Q25.explanation: The RBI commenced operations on 1 April 1935 under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934. The Act was passed in 1934, but the question asks the start date of the institution; RBI commenced business on 1 April 1935.

mpsc-group-b-steno-2025-gk-Q18.expectedStem: According to World Bank, what is the projected growth rate of Indian economy over the next two fiscal years (2025-2027)?
mpsc-group-b-steno-2025-gk-Q18.explanation: Option C is the best answer: 6.7%. The number is the World Bank forecast cited by this paper, not an observed growth rate. Forecast vintages change, so the specified 2025–27 horizon matters.

mpsc-group-b-steno-2025-gk-Q64.expectedStem: The Head Quarters of World Bank is in-
mpsc-group-b-steno-2025-gk-Q64.explanation: Option A is the best answer: Washington. Its two main headquarters buildings are in Washington, D.C.; New York is associated with the UN headquarters.

mpsc-group-b-station-officer-2018-gk-Q3.expectedStem: NITI Aayog has launched which global mobility hackathon to crowdsource solutions for future of mobility in India?
mpsc-group-b-station-officer-2018-gk-Q3.explanation: NITI Aayog called the global mobility hackathon MoveHack 2018. “MoveHack” is the mobility-themed name; the other three choices are unrelated phrases.

mpsc-group-b-station-officer-2018-gk-Q47.expectedStem: Who is the current Governor of Reserve Bank of India?
mpsc-group-b-station-officer-2018-gk-Q47.explanation: Urjit Patel was RBI Governor in October 2018; he resigned in December 2018. The word “current” is anchored to the 2018 paper. Raghuram Rajan and D. Subbarao were earlier governors, while Patel was then in office.

mpsc-group-b-station-officer-2018-gk-Q82.expectedStem: SHG is a small voluntary association of poor people, preferably from the same socio-economic background. The “G” in SHG stands for:
mpsc-group-b-station-officer-2018-gk-Q82.explanation: SHG means Self-Help Group, so G stands for Group. The members pool savings and access credit together, making “Group” the substantive final word in the abbreviation.

mpsc-group-b-mes-pwd-2018-gs-Q91.expectedStem: National Income of a country is also known as:
mpsc-group-b-mes-pwd-2018-gs-Q91.explanation: National income is conventionally measured as NNP at factor cost. NNP deducts depreciation from GNP; measuring that net national output at factor cost yields the conventional national-income aggregate.

mpsc-group-b-mes-power-2018-gs-Q38.expectedStem: Which one of the following taxes at the State level is being subsumed into GST?
mpsc-group-b-mes-power-2018-gs-Q38.explanation: State VAT was subsumed into GST. VAT was a state tax on sale of goods that GST absorbed; service tax, countervailing duty and central excise were central-level levies.

mpsc-group-b-assistant-grade-2018-p2-A27.expectedStem: Who is the present governor of Reserve Bank of India (RBI)?
mpsc-group-b-assistant-grade-2018-p2-A27.explanation: Option B is correct: Urjit Patel. At the 2018 paper date Patel had succeeded Raghuram Rajan; Viral Acharya and S. S. Mundra were deputy governors.

mpsc-group-b-assistant-grade-2018-p2-A39.expectedStem: The Managing director of International Monetary Fund is:
mpsc-group-b-assistant-grade-2018-p2-A39.explanation: Option A is correct: Christine Lagarde. This is a paper-date question: Lagarde led the IMF from 2011 to 2019, before Kristalina Georgieva succeeded her.

mpsc-group-b-assistant-grade-2018-p2-A40.expectedStem: The Vice-Chairman of NITI Aayog is:
mpsc-group-b-assistant-grade-2018-p2-A40.explanation: Option B is correct: Rajiv Kumar. Rajiv Kumar succeeded Arvind Panagariya as vice-chairperson in 2017 and held the post at the 2018 sitting.

mpsc-group-b-acf-2018-gk-Q100.explanation: Option C is the best answer: Fish Production. “Blue” points to water-based production, particularly fisheries and aquaculture, rather than meat, grain or apples.

mpsc-group-b-ada-2014-gk-Q40.expectedStem: Presently, who is the President of the World Bank?
mpsc-group-b-ada-2014-gk-Q40.explanation: Jim Yong Kim was World Bank president in 2014 (D). Jim Yong Kim served as World Bank president from 2012 to 2019, covering the year of this 2014 paper.

mpsc-group-b-ada-2014-gk-Q47.expectedStem: Who is the current Governor of Reserve Bank of India?
mpsc-group-b-ada-2014-gk-Q47.explanation: Raghuram Rajan was RBI Governor in 2014 (D). Rajan took office in September 2013, after D. Subbarao, and therefore held the governorship at the 2014 sitting.

mpsc-group-b-mes-phe-2014-gs-Q12.expectedStem: Who is Chairman of Planning Commission?
mpsc-group-b-mes-phe-2014-gs-Q12.explanation: The Prime Minister chaired India’s Planning Commission. The Prime Minister was ex-officio chair of the former Planning Commission; its day-to-day leadership also included a deputy chair.

mpsc-group-b-aao-2025-p2-Q27.expectedStem: What is the target fiscal deficit as a percentage of GDP for 2025–26?
mpsc-group-b-aao-2025-p2-Q27.explanation: The Union Budget 2025–26 sets the fiscal-deficit target at 4.4% of GDP. This is the budget estimate for FY 2025–26, representing planned central-government borrowing as a share of GDP; it should not be read as the later realised deficit.

mpsc-group-b-hfw-2026-p2-Q33.expectedStem: Human Development Index (HDI) is calculated using which three indicators?
mpsc-group-b-hfw-2026-p2-Q33.explanation: The HDI combines indicators of health, education and standard of living (income). Life expectancy measures health; mean and expected years of schooling measure education; GNI per person measures living standards.

mpsc-group-b-assistant-grade-mpsc-2019-p.expectedStem: At what percent, fiscal deficit for the budget of 2019-2020 has been pegged?
mpsc-group-b-assistant-grade-mpsc-2019-p.explanation: The Interim Budget projected a 3.4% fiscal deficit for FY 2019–20. The question refers to the Interim Budget forecast for FY2019–20; 3.4% was its announced fiscal-deficit ratio, not a current estimate.

mpsc-group-b-assistant-grade-mpsc-2019-p.expectedStem: What is the India’s GDP growth rate forecast for the year 2018, as per latest report by Moody’s Investors Service?
mpsc-group-b-assistant-grade-mpsc-2019-p.explanation: Moody’s reported a 7.5% India growth forecast for 2018. The wording fixes Moody’s contemporaneous 2018 forecast. GDP forecasts are time-specific predictions and differ from subsequent realised growth.

mpsc-group-b-dso-2019-gs1-Q47.explanation: NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission in 2015. The replacement institution was constituted on 1 January 2015, distinguishing it from the 2014 announcement of the reform.

mpsc-group-b-dso-2019-gs1-Q48.expectedStem: Green Revolution was started in India in the
mpsc-group-b-dso-2019-gs1-Q48.explanation: India’s Green Revolution began in the 1960s. High-yielding wheat and rice varieties were introduced and expanded from the mid-1960s, identifying that decade.

mpsc-group-b-dso-2019-gs1-Q51.expectedStem: Which among the following is the method to estimate the poverty line in India?
mpsc-group-b-dso-2019-gs1-Q51.explanation: India’s poverty line has traditionally been estimated using consumption expenditure. The older official poverty estimates were built from household consumption-expenditure surveys rather than reported income.

mpsc-group-b-dso-2019-gs1-Q54.expectedStem: Which base year is currently used to calculate per capita income in India?
mpsc-group-b-dso-2019-gs1-Q54.explanation: The 2011–12 series was the then-current national accounts base year. At the 2019 paper date, the national-accounts series used 2011–12 as its base; the base year has since been revised.

mpsc-group-b-dso-2019-gs1-Q73.expectedStem: The Five Year Plan in India that gave priority to heavy industry was ..........
mpsc-group-b-dso-2019-gs1-Q73.explanation: The Second Five Year Plan prioritized heavy industry. The Mahalanobis strategy placed capital goods and heavy industry at the centre of the Second Plan (1956–61).

mpsc-group-b-do-mar-2019-gs1-Q49.expectedStem: The term ‘Green Revolution’ is also known as
mpsc-group-b-do-mar-2019-gs1-Q49.explanation: The Green Revolution is also called the New Agricultural Strategy. The phrase refers to high-yield seed varieties supported by irrigation, fertiliser and other inputs, a new strategy for raising crop output.

mpsc-group-b-do-mar-2019-gs1-Q54.expectedStem: Since the First Plan, the share of Agriculture and Allied Services in the GDP is
mpsc-group-b-do-mar-2019-gs1-Q54.explanation: Agriculture and allied activities’ share of GDP has declined since the First Plan. Agriculture grew in absolute output, but industry and services expanded faster, reducing agriculture’s percentage share of GDP.

mpsc-group-b-do-mar-2019-gs1-Q56.expectedStem: Which of the followings is among the credit control methods used by the RBI?
mpsc-group-b-do-mar-2019-gs1-Q56.explanation: Moral suasion is a qualitative credit-control instrument used by the RBI. Moral suasion means RBI persuading banks to alter lending behaviour; issuing currency is a separate central-bank function.

mpsc-group-b-do-mar-2019-gs1-Q69.expectedStem: The main impact of the Green Revolution has been on
mpsc-group-b-do-mar-2019-gs1-Q69.explanation: The Green Revolution’s main impact was on cereal crops, especially wheat and rice. The largest gains came from high-yielding wheat and rice, both cereal foodgrains; pulses, fruits and vegetables saw less of the initial impact.

mpsc-group-b-do-mar-2019-gs2-Q19.expectedStem: The headquarters of International Monetary fund is located in
mpsc-group-b-do-mar-2019-gs2-Q19.explanation: The IMF headquarters is in Washington, D.C. The IMF is based in Washington, D.C.; New York is the UN’s headquarters, while Vienna and Geneva house other international bodies.

mpsc-group-b-do-oct-2019-gs1-Q2.expectedStem: Who among the following Indian freedom fighters produced for the first time statistical estimate of average per capita income of India?
mpsc-group-b-do-oct-2019-gs1-Q2.explanation: Dadabhai Naoroji was the first to estimate India’s average per-capita income. Naoroji used early statistics to estimate Indian national and per-capita income, linked to his “drain of wealth” analysis.

mpsc-group-b-do-oct-2019-gs1-Q49.expectedStem: The term ‘Green Revolution’ is also known as
mpsc-group-b-do-oct-2019-gs1-Q49.explanation: The Green Revolution is also called the New Agricultural Strategy. This “new strategy” used high-yielding seeds with irrigation and fertiliser to increase foodgrain yields.

mpsc-group-b-do-oct-2019-gs1-Q54.expectedStem: Among different sectors, the contribution for India’s National Income is largest from
mpsc-group-b-do-oct-2019-gs1-Q54.explanation: The services sector contributes the largest share of India’s national income. Services include trade, transport, finance and other activities; together they contribute more to national income than agriculture or industry.

mpsc-group-b-do-oct-2019-gs1-Q56.expectedStem: Which of the followings is among the credit control methods used by the RBI?
mpsc-group-b-do-oct-2019-gs1-Q56.explanation: The bank rate is a quantitative credit-control tool used by the Reserve Bank of India. Changing the bank rate influences the cost of borrowing from RBI and thus overall bank credit; issuing currency is a different function.

mpsc-group-b-eo-2019-gs2-Q40.expectedStem: The Reserve Bank of India was established on :
mpsc-group-b-eo-2019-gs2-Q40.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India began operations on 1 April 1935. The RBI Act dates from 1934, but the central bank opened for business on 1 April 1935.

mpsc-group-b-eo-2019-gs2-Q43.expectedStem: Goods and Service Tax (GST) is implemented With effect from:
mpsc-group-b-eo-2019-gs2-Q43.explanation: GST took effect on 1 July 2017. India introduced the nationwide GST regime on 1 July 2017, replacing many central and state indirect taxes.

mpsc-group-b-eo-2019-gs2-Q48.explanation: The Green Revolution combined high-yielding seeds, fertilizers and new technology. High-yielding seeds produced the gains only when supported by fertiliser, irrigation and improved cultivation technology, so all three listed elements apply.

mpsc-group-b-eo-2019-gs2-Q54.expectedStem: The basic objective of Twelfth Five Year Plan (2012 – 17) is:
expectedOptions: Faster, more inclusive and sustainable growth
Healthy inter-dependence between agriculture and industry
mpsc-group-b-eo-2019-gs2-Q54.explanation: The Twelfth Plan’s theme was faster, more inclusive and sustainable growth. The plan title combines growth speed, broad participation and environmental sustainability; the other options narrow the aim to one sector.

mpsc-group-b-eo-2019-gs2-Q55.expectedStem: Revenue deficit arises when the Government’s :
expectedOptions: Actual net receipts is lower than the projected receipts
mpsc-group-b-eo-2019-gs2-Q55.explanation: Revenue deficit occurs when revenue expenditure exceeds revenue receipts. Strictly, this means revenue expenditure exceeds revenue receipts; borrowing or a shortfall against forecasts alone does not define a revenue deficit.

mpsc-group-b-eo-2019-gs2-Q63.expectedStem: The share of agriculture in Indian National Income is:
mpsc-group-b-eo-2019-gs2-Q63.explanation: Agriculture’s share of national income has declined over time. The share falls when industry and services grow faster, even if agricultural production itself rises.

mpsc-group-b-eo-2019-gs3-Q66.expectedStem: According to the Mizoram Economic Survey 2016-2017, State Per Capita income of Mizoram in 2015-2016 is
mpsc-group-b-eo-2019-gs3-Q66.explanation: The 2016–17 Economic Survey gives 2015–16 per-capita income as Rs 85,659. This is a nominal state per-capita-income figure tied to 2015–16; the nearby options are different amounts.

mpsc-group-b-fr-2019-science-3-Q2.expectedStem: During green revolution in India the crops introduced are:
mpsc-group-b-fr-2019-science-3-Q2.explanation: The Green Revolution relied on high-yielding varieties. These varieties raised yield per hectare, particularly for wheat and rice, when paired with water and fertiliser.

mpsc-group-b-fr-2019-science-3-Q10.expectedStem: To reduce the environmental impact the Government of India reduce tax for electric vehicle. The new GST for electric vehicle in 2019 stands:
mpsc-group-b-fr-2019-science-3-Q10.explanation: The 2019 GST rate for electric vehicles was reduced to 5%. The GST Council cut the electric-vehicle rate from 12% to 5% in 2019 as a lower-tax incentive for cleaner transport.

mpsc-group-b-iof-2019-gs-Q37.expectedStem: Where was the ‘Deccan Dialogue-Conference on Economic Development’ organized on May 6, 2018?
mpsc-group-b-iof-2019-gs-Q37.explanation: The Deccan Dialogue was held in Hyderabad. The event name refers to the Deccan region; contemporary event notices place the 6 May 2018 conference in Hyderabad.

mpsc-group-b-iof-2019-gs-Q93.expectedStem: Which state tops in the list of “Healthy States, Progressive India” published by Niti Aayog in the month of February, 2018?
mpsc-group-b-iof-2019-gs-Q93.explanation: Kerala topped NITI Aayog’s 2018 Healthy States index among the listed choices. The answer is for the 2018 report and its larger-state comparison; a different edition or category can produce a different leader.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs1-Q.expectedStem: The present Governor of the Reserve Bank of India is
mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs1-Q.explanation: Shaktikanta Das was RBI Governor in November 2019. Das took office in December 2018 after Urjit Patel and remained governor when this 2019 exam was set.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs1-Q.expectedStem: In May 2016, the Reserve Bank of India Act 1934 was amended to provide a statutory basis for the implementation of which of the following:
mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs1-Q.explanation: The 2016 amendment provided the statutory basis for flexible inflation targeting. The amendment underpins the Monetary Policy Committee and an inflation target with tolerance band, rather than a deflation, ombudsman or KYC framework.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs1-Q.expectedStem: Who among the following has resigned as Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of India recently?
mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs1-Q.explanation: Viral Acharya resigned as RBI Deputy Governor in 2019. Acharya announced an early departure from his RBI deputy governorship in 2019; the other names held different positions.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs1-Q.expectedStem: According to the National Statistic Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, India’s GDP growth rate in the Q1 (April-June) 2019-20 was
mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs1-Q.explanation: The NSO’s initial estimate for Q1 FY2019–20 GDP growth was 5.0%. This is the first official GDP release for April–June 2019, in which year-on-year real growth was reported as 5.0%.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs1-Q.expectedStem: The fiscal deficit of the Union Government of India for the FY 2018-19 was
mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs1-Q.explanation: The revised FY2018–19 Union fiscal deficit was 3.4% of GDP. The 3.4% figure is the contemporaneous revised estimate for the Union fiscal deficit as a percentage of GDP, not an absolute rupee amount.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs1-Q.expectedStem: The Reserve Bank of India reduced the repo rate by 25 basis points in June 2019. The repo rate after this announcement is ___
mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs1-Q.explanation: After the June 2019 cut, the repo rate was 5.75%. A 25-basis-point cut equals 0.25 percentage points: 6.00% before the June decision became 5.75% afterward.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs2-Q.expectedStem: Developmental administration which focuses upon socio-economic development for the people is the administrative responsibility of the
mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs2-Q.explanation: A permanent bureaucracy provides administrative continuity across elected governments. Civil servants implement development programmes and maintain administration between elections, while elected politicians set political direction.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs2-Q.expectedStem: Which of the following crops are related to Green Revolution?
mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs2-Q.explanation: Wheat and rice are the principal foodgrains in India. Early high-yield varieties were adopted most prominently for wheat and rice, matching that crop pair.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs2-Q.expectedStem: If there were a balance of payments deficit then in a floating exchange rate system:
expectedOptions: The external value of currency would tend to fall
The external value of currency would tend to rise
The injections from trade are greater than the withdrawal
mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs2-Q.explanation: A floating deficit can put downward pressure on a currency through depreciation. In a floating regime the central bank does not maintain a fixed parity; excess demand for foreign currency tends to depreciate the domestic currency.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs2-Q.expectedStem: Niti Aayog is based on which of the following pillars of effective governance? (i)Pro-people agenda(ii)Pro-active (iii)Participative(iv)Transparency (v)Accountability(vi)Quality of service
expectedOptions: i, ii, iii, iv and v
mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs2-Q.explanation: The selected choice includes all the listed pillars of the programme. The listed principles combine service quality, accountability, transparency and participation, so omitting any listed pillar would be incomplete.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs2-Q.expectedStem: NABARD was established in 1982 on the recommendation of:
mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs2-Q.explanation: The Sivaraman Committee recommended institutional credit reforms for rural development. The Committee to Review Arrangements for Institutional Credit for Agriculture and Rural Development, chaired by B. Sivaraman, led to NABARD’s creation.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs2-Q.expectedStem: Which among the following is not part of fiscal policy?
mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs2-Q.explanation: Interest rates are a key instrument/transmission channel of monetary policy. Fiscal policy uses government tax and spending choices. Interest-rate policy belongs to monetary policy conducted through the central bank.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs2-Q.expectedStem: First Five Year Plan was based on:
mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs2-Q.explanation: The Harrod–Domar model links growth to savings and capital-output ratios. The First Plan stressed agriculture and irrigation and used the Harrod–Domar savings-and-investment growth framework; Mahalanobis is linked to the Second Plan.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs2-Q.expectedStem: Green revolution in India is associated with increased of food grain production and, which of the following food crop benefited the most?
mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs2-Q.explanation: Wheat is a major rabi crop of the northern plains. Early high-yielding varieties produced especially large gains in wheat output, more than in the other three listed crops.

mpsc-group-b-mes-phe-2019-gs-Q23.expectedStem: Which committee has been constituted by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to look into bank frauds?
mpsc-group-b-mes-phe-2019-gs-Q23.explanation: The RBI formed the Y.H. Malegam committee to examine bank frauds and related issues. The Y. H. Malegam panel was appointed to examine bank-fraud issues; the other committee names do not match that RBI inquiry.

mpsc-group-b-mes-phe-2019-gs-Q57.expectedStem: In the budget of Mizoram 2018-19. How much amount was allocated for implementation of the New Economic Development Policy (NEDP)?
mpsc-group-b-mes-phe-2019-gs-Q57.explanation: Mizoram’s 2018–19 Budget Estimate earmarked ₹1,000 crore for NEDP. The figure is the allocation in the specified 2018–19 Mizoram budget for the New Economic Development Policy, not the policy’s total multiyear cost.

mpsc-group-b-mes-phe-2019-gs-Q59.expectedStem: The base year currently in use for measuring national income in India, also known as national income at constant price is -
mpsc-group-b-mes-phe-2019-gs-Q59.explanation: India’s national-income constant-price series uses 2011–12 as its base year. Constant-price income removes inflation by valuing output at prices from a fixed base year, which was 2011–12 for this 2019 paper.

mpsc-group-b-udc-agri-2019-p2-A12.expectedStem: Who was appointed as the 25th Governor of the Reserve Bank of India on 11th December 2018?
mpsc-group-b-udc-agri-2019-p2-A12.explanation: Das was appointed after Urjit Patel’s resignation, becoming the twenty-fifth person to lead RBI.

mpsc-group-b-udc-agri-2019-p2-A18.expectedStem: As per the revised GST norms, the GST on Haj has been reduced from 18 per cent to
mpsc-group-b-udc-agri-2019-p2-A18.explanation: The revised rate for Haj pilgrimage services was 5%, a decrease of 13 percentage points from 18%.

mpsc-group-b-udc-agri-2019-p2-B108.expectedStem: The marked price of a scooty is Rs 54,000 and GST of 4 % is charged on it. The total  amount to be paid for the scooty is
mpsc-group-b-udc-agri-2019-p2-B108.explanation: GST is 4% of ₹54,000, or ₹2,160. Adding it to the marked price gives ₹56,160.

mpsc-group-b-udc-dc-serchhip-2019-p2-A13.expectedStem: Who was selected as the 13th president of the World Bank on April 5, 2019?
mpsc-group-b-udc-dc-serchhip-2019-p2-A13.explanation: David Malpass was elected World Bank president. The World Bank selected Malpass in April 2019 to succeed Jim Yong Kim; the other names were not its president-elect.

mpsc-group-b-udc-forensic-2019-p2-A9.expectedStem: Blue revolution is the intense growth of ____________ technology.
mpsc-group-b-udc-forensic-2019-p2-A9.explanation: The Blue Revolution concerns aquaculture and fish production. Aquaculture is the cultivation of fish and other aquatic organisms; that production is the focus of the Blue Revolution.

mpsc-group-b-udc-forensic-2019-p2-A14.expectedStem: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has approved which country’s Pasargad Bank to open branches in Mumbai for easing trade related transactions on 2019?
mpsc-group-b-udc-forensic-2019-p2-A14.explanation: Pasargad Bank is Iranian. Pasargad Bank is an Iranian bank, so the proposed Mumbai branch related to Iran–India trade.

mpsc-group-b-udc-forensic-2019-p2-A37.expectedStem: The biggest economy in the world in terms of GDP purchasing power parity is
mpsc-group-b-udc-forensic-2019-p2-A37.explanation: China had the largest GDP by purchasing power parity. Purchasing-power parity adjusts GDP for domestic price levels, under which China exceeded the United States in the cited period.

mpsc-group-b-udc-forensic-2019-p2-A62.expectedStem: GST, introduced by Government of India is
mpsc-group-b-udc-forensic-2019-p2-A62.explanation: GST means Goods and Services Tax. GST is the broad indirect tax on supplies of goods and services, rather than any of the unrelated “survey” or “transport” expansions.

mpsc-group-b-udc-horti-2019-p2-A11.expectedStem: Which state tops the Innovation Index 2019 launched by the NITI Aayog?
mpsc-group-b-udc-horti-2019-p2-A11.explanation: Karnataka is the state. The 2019 India Innovation Index placed Karnataka first among major states; the question refers to that edition.

mpsc-group-b-udc-horti-2019-p2-A22.expectedStem: The amount of money given by RBI to the Central government- its highest transfer ever-sparking a fierce debate in India is
mpsc-group-b-udc-horti-2019-p2-A22.explanation: The RBI transferred ₹1.76 lakh crore in surplus. The record transfer was the RBI’s 2018–19 surplus plus excess provisions, totaling about ₹1.76 lakh crore to the Union government.

mpsc-group-b-udc-revenue-2019-p2-A36.expectedStem: Green Revolution is also known as
mpsc-group-b-udc-revenue-2019-p2-A36.explanation: The Green Revolution is commonly called the Second Agricultural Revolution. The term points to the major second phase of agricultural productivity growth through high-yield seeds, irrigation and fertiliser.

mpsc-group-b-udc-mpsc-2019-p2-B84.expectedStem: The price of a scooter is Rs 54,000 and GST of 28% is charged on it. The total amount to be paid for the scooter is

mpsc-group-b-udc-rd-2019-p2-A9.expectedStem: Which among the following banks was not penalised for non-compliance with various directions issued by the Reserve Bank of India?
mpsc-group-b-udc-rd-2019-p2-A9.explanation: ICICI Bank was not among the banks penalized in the cited RBI action. This item depends on the specific RBI penalties reported near the 2019 exam date; the other three banks were named in that enforcement action.

mpsc-group-b-udc-rd-2019-p2-A24.expectedStem: Which country tops the list under Human Capital Index launched by World Bank?
mpsc-group-b-udc-rd-2019-p2-A24.explanation: Singapore topped the World Bank Human Capital Index. The World Bank’s inaugural Human Capital Index ranked Singapore first; it combines expected health and education outcomes.

mpsc-group-b-udc-rd-2019-p2-A26.expectedStem: Who is appointed as the 25th Governor of the Reserve Bank of India?
mpsc-group-b-udc-rd-2019-p2-A26.explanation: Shaktikanta Das was the 25th RBI Governor. Das succeeded Urjit Patel in December 2018, making him RBI’s twenty-fifth governor.

mpsc-group-b-udc-rd-2019-p2-A31.expectedStem: Who is the first Indian woman to be appointed as Chief Economist of IMF?
mpsc-group-b-udc-rd-2019-p2-A31.explanation: Gita Gopinath became IMF Chief Economist. Gopinath was appointed IMF chief economist in 2018 and took up the role in 2019; the other candidates did not hold that post.

mpsc-group-b-udc-transport-2019-p2-A4.expectedStem: India has raised customs duty to 200 per cent on all goods imported from which nation?
mpsc-group-b-udc-transport-2019-p2-A4.explanation: India raised import duties on Pakistani goods to 200% after Pulwama. This followed the February 2019 Pulwama attack and withdrawal of Pakistan’s most-favoured-nation trade status.

mpsc-group-b-eo-leit-2019-gs2-Q40.expectedStem: The Reserve Bank of India was established on :
mpsc-group-b-eo-leit-2019-gs2-Q40.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India began operations on 1 April 1935. The Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 enabled its creation; it commenced business on 1 April 1935.

mpsc-group-b-eo-leit-2019-gs2-Q43.expectedStem: Goods and Service Tax (GST) is implemented With effect from:
mpsc-group-b-eo-leit-2019-gs2-Q43.explanation: GST took effect across India on 1 July 2017. The nationwide goods-and-services tax began on 1 July 2017, absorbing multiple earlier indirect taxes.

mpsc-group-b-eo-leit-2019-gs2-Q54.expectedStem: The basic objective of Twelfth Five Year Plan (2012 – 17) is:
expectedOptions: Faster, more inclusive and sustainable growth
Healthy inter-dependence between agriculture and industry
mpsc-group-b-eo-leit-2019-gs2-Q54.explanation: The Twelfth Plan’s stated theme was faster, more inclusive and sustainable growth. The Twelfth Plan’s title explicitly combined faster growth with inclusion and sustainability over 2012–17.

mpsc-group-b-eo-leit-2019-gs2-Q63.expectedStem: The share of agriculture in Indian National Income is:
mpsc-group-b-eo-leit-2019-gs2-Q63.explanation: Agriculture’s share of national income has declined as industry and services expanded. The percentage share fell as services and industry expanded faster than farm output; “diminishing” refers to share, not necessarily absolute production.

mpsc-group-b-eo-leit-2019-gs3-Q66.expectedStem: According to the Mizoram Economic Survey 2016-2017, state per-capita income of Mizoram in 2015-2016 is
mpsc-group-b-eo-leit-2019-gs3-Q66.explanation: The 2016–17 Economic Survey gives 2015–16 per-capita income as Rs 85,659. The question cites the 2016–17 Economic Survey and asks for its 2015–16 estimate, so ₹85,659 is tied to that specific year.

mpsc-group-b-ae-civil-tourism-2020-gs-Q9.expectedStem: The NITI Aayog and which international organization launched “The Gandhian Challenge”?
mpsc-group-b-ae-civil-tourism-2020-gs-Q9.explanation: The NITI Aayog launched The Gandhian Challenge with UNICEF (C). The Gandhian Challenge invited ideas from young people around Mahatma Gandhi’s principles and was a NITI Aayog–UNICEF initiative.

mpsc-group-b-udc-arc-2020-p2-A5.expectedStem: What is India’s rank in Human Development Index-2019?
mpsc-group-b-udc-arc-2020-p2-A5.explanation: India ranked 129th in the 2019 Human Development Report. The 2019 UNDP Human Development Report listed India at 129th; ranks vary with report year and country coverage.

mpsc-group-b-udc-arc-2020-p2-A29.expectedStem: What is the GDP (Gross Domestic Product) growth of India for the current financial year-FY 20 as per Asian Development Bank?
mpsc-group-b-udc-arc-2020-p2-A29.explanation: ADB forecast India’s FY2020 growth at 5.1%. ADB’s forecast was 5.1% for FY2019–20 in the release relevant to the paper; forecast vintages should not be replaced by later actuals.

mpsc-group-b-aap-2020-gs-Q11.expectedStem: What was the position of India in the World Bank’s Human Capital Index 2020?
mpsc-group-b-aap-2020-gs-Q11.explanation: India ranked 116th in the 2020 Human Capital Index. The index measures expected human-capital productivity from child survival, schooling and health; India’s 2020 rank was 116th.

mpsc-group-b-aap-2020-gs-Q13.expectedStem: According to the reports of the finance ministry, India’s GDP during April-June period was contracted by
mpsc-group-b-aap-2020-gs-Q13.explanation: India’s GDP contracted 23.9% in April–June 2020. The first pandemic lockdown quarter, April–June 2020, recorded a year-on-year real GDP contraction of 23.9%.

mpsc-group-b-aap-2020-gs-Q58.expectedStem: National Income in India is estimated by?
mpsc-group-b-aap-2020-gs-Q58.explanation: The Central Statistical Organization (now NSO) estimates national income. The CSO compiled India’s official national accounts; it has since been incorporated into the National Statistical Office.

mpsc-group-b-aap-2020-gs-Q60.expectedStem: The rate at which RBI gives short term loan to commercial banks is called
mpsc-group-b-aap-2020-gs-Q60.explanation: Repo rate is the rate at which RBI lends short-term to banks. Under a repo transaction a bank receives funds from RBI against securities and agrees to repurchase them; reverse repo moves funds the other way.

mpsc-group-b-aap-2020-gs-Q62.expectedStem: The blue revolution is related with
mpsc-group-b-aap-2020-gs-Q62.explanation: The Blue Revolution concerns fish production. It refers to increasing fish output through fisheries and aquaculture, unlike the white revolution for milk.

mpsc-group-b-mes-pwd-2020-gs-Q77.expectedStem: The central banking functions in India are performed by the i)Central Bank of India ii)Reserve Bank of India iii)State Bank of India iv)Punjab National Bank
mpsc-group-b-mes-pwd-2020-gs-Q77.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India performs India’s central-banking functions. The similarly named Central Bank of India is a commercial bank. Only RBI is India’s monetary authority and bank regulator.

mpsc-group-b-mes-pwd-2020-gs-Q81.expectedStem: If the cash reserve ratio is lowered by the RBI, its impact on credit creation will be to –
mpsc-group-b-mes-pwd-2020-gs-Q81.explanation: A lower CRR frees more bank funds for lending and expands credit creation. CRR is the fraction of deposits banks must keep with RBI. Reducing it releases funds that banks can lend, raising potential credit creation.

mpsc-group-b-mpe-ss-2020-gk-Q2.expectedStem: How much percent of India’s GDP is set as a target to raise health services expenditure by 2025?
mpsc-group-b-mpe-ss-2020-gk-Q2.explanation: The National Health Policy 2017 set a goal of public health spending reaching 2.5% of GDP by 2025.

mpsc-group-b-mpe-ss-2020-gk-Q4.expectedStem: What is the GDP growth of India for the year 2018-19?
mpsc-group-b-mpe-ss-2020-gk-Q4.explanation: The 6.8% figure is the GDP growth estimate cited for FY2018–19 in the source period; later revisions can change historical growth series.

mpsc-group-b-mpe-ss-2020-gk-Q34.expectedStem: If the cash reserve ratio is lowered by the RBI, its impact on credit creation will be to
mpsc-group-b-mpe-ss-2020-gk-Q34.explanation: CRR is required cash held at RBI. A lower requirement leaves banks more lendable deposits, increasing their capacity to create credit.

mpsc-group-b-mpe-ss-2020-gk-Q35.expectedStem: In India, which one among the following formulates the fiscal policy?
mpsc-group-b-mpe-ss-2020-gk-Q35.explanation: Taxation, expenditure and the Union Budget are handled by the Ministry of Finance; RBI mainly conducts monetary policy.

mpsc-group-b-mpe-ss-2020-gk-Q53.expectedStem: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) observed Financial Literacy (FL) Week on?
mpsc-group-b-mpe-ss-2020-gk-Q53.explanation: The RBI’s 2019 Financial Literacy Week ran from Monday 3 June through Friday 7 June, matching option D.

mpsc-group-b-mpe-ss-2020-gk-Q56.expectedStem: What is the limit of Ways and Means Advances (WMA) set up by Reserve Bank of India(RBI) for the first half of the financial year 2019-20?
mpsc-group-b-mpe-ss-2020-gk-Q56.explanation: RBI’s announced WMA ceiling for the Union government in April–September 2019 was ₹75,000 crore; WMA covers temporary cash-flow gaps.

mpsc-group-b-mpe-ss-2020-gk-Q57.expectedStem: Name the Scheme,funded by the World Bank and the Government of India,in order to strengthen the unorganised food processing sector concentrated in rural areas?
expectedOptions: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
mpsc-group-b-mpe-ss-2020-gk-Q57.explanation: The proposed Gram Samridhi Yojana targeted rural unorganised food-processing enterprises with World Bank and Indian-government support.

mpsc-group-b-mpe-ss-2020-gk-Q62.expectedStem: Foreign Direct Investment ceilings in the telecom sector have been raised from 74 percent to
mpsc-group-b-mpe-ss-2020-gk-Q62.explanation: The policy change permitted up to 100% foreign direct investment in telecom, above the previous 74% ceiling.

mpsc-group-b-mpe-ss-2020-gk-Q63.expectedStem: The chairman of NITI Aayog is
mpsc-group-b-mpe-ss-2020-gk-Q63.explanation: The Prime Minister chairs NITI Aayog by design; its vice-chairperson and CEO are separate posts.

mpsc-group-b-mpe-ss-2020-gk-Q64.expectedStem: National Income estimates in India are prepared by
mpsc-group-b-mpe-ss-2020-gk-Q64.explanation: The CSO was the official statistics agency compiling national-income aggregates; this function now sits within the NSO.

mpsc-group-b-mpe-ss-2020-gk-Q69.expectedStem: The First Five Year Plan was based on:
mpsc-group-b-mpe-ss-2020-gk-Q69.explanation: Harrod–Domar links growth to savings and investment, while the Mahalanobis heavy-industry model characterized the Second Plan.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-fcs-2019-gs2-Q19.expectedStem: Which of the following replaced the Planning Commission?
mpsc-group-b-inspector-fcs-2019-gs2-Q19.explanation: NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission in 2015. NITI Aayog was created in 2015 to replace the Planning Commission as the government’s policy think tank.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-fcs-2019-gs2-Q44.expectedStem: For which type of crop was Minimum Support Price (MSP) first announced by the Government of India in 1966-67?
mpsc-group-b-inspector-fcs-2019-gs2-Q44.explanation: Wheat was the first crop for which minimum support prices were announced in 1966–67. The first MSP announcement in 1966–67 was for wheat amid the early Green Revolution; later MSP coverage expanded to other crops.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-fcs-2019-gs2-Q54.expectedStem: Buying of securities by RBI leads to______
mpsc-group-b-inspector-fcs-2019-gs2-Q54.explanation: When RBI buys securities, it pays funds into the market, increasing liquidity. Buying government securities pays money to sellers and adds reserves to banks, increasing market liquidity; selling does the reverse.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-fcs-2019-gs2-Q58.expectedStem: Which Five-Year Plan of India had adopted ‘Removal of Poverty’ as its foremost objective?
mpsc-group-b-inspector-fcs-2019-gs2-Q58.explanation: The Sixth Five-Year Plan (1980–85) emphasised poverty alleviation and employment. The Sixth Plan (1980–85) put poverty removal and employment at the centre of its objectives; the earlier plans stressed other priorities.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-fcs-2019-gs2-Q61.expectedStem: Per capita income of India as per IMF estimate in 2017 is
mpsc-group-b-inspector-fcs-2019-gs2-Q61.explanation: The IMF’s nominal per-capita GDP estimate for India in 2017 was approximately US$1,983. This is a nominal US-dollar estimate for 2017; it is distinct from a purchasing-power-parity figure, which would be much higher.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-fcs-2019-gs2-Q69.expectedStem: Reserve Bank of India fixed the cash reserve ratio now at
mpsc-group-b-inspector-fcs-2019-gs2-Q69.explanation: The RBI’s cash reserve ratio at the time of this 2019 paper was 4%. At the 2019 sitting RBI required commercial banks to hold 4% of eligible deposits as cash reserves; the rate changes over time.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-fcs-2019-gs2-Q71.explanation: The Prime Minister of India chairs NITI Aayog. The Prime Minister is NITI Aayog’s ex-officio chairperson; the other constitutional officers listed do not hold that role.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-jr-grade-of-mls.expectedStem: Name Chief Economist of World Bank
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-jr-grade-of-mls.explanation: Indermit Gill became the World Bank’s Chief Economist. Gill was appointed in 2022 as the World Bank’s Chief Economist and Senior Vice President for Development Economics.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-jr-grade-of-mls.expectedStem: Name the country who recently joined Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership(CPTPP), unlocking access to a region with a total GDP of $13.6 trillion.
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-jr-grade-of-mls.explanation: The UK signed its accession protocol in July 2023, which explains the paper’s wording; formal membership began on 15 December 2024.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-jr-grade-of-mls.expectedStem: Name the new mobile app launched on 22 March 2023 for Taxpayers by Income Tax Department.
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-jr-grade-of-mls.explanation: The Income Tax Department launched the AIS for Taxpayers app. AIS stands for Annual Information Statement, and the app allows taxpayers to view their reported tax information on a phone.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-jr-grade-of-mls.expectedStem: According to the National Statistical Office on 5th March 2023, India’s Per Capita Income was estimated at
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-jr-grade-of-mls.explanation: The NSO estimate cited in the paper was per-capita income of ₹1,72,000. The amount corresponds to the NSO’s then-current per-capita net national income estimate at current prices, around ₹1.72 lakh.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-jr-grade-of-mls.expectedStem: Chief Executive Officer of NITI Aayog is
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-jr-grade-of-mls.explanation: B. V. R. Subrahmanyam became NITI Aayog’s CEO in February 2023. He assumed the NITI Aayog CEO post in 2023, succeeding Parameswaran Iyer; the other listed people held different posts.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-acf-2023-genera.expectedStem: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) was established in the year
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-acf-2023-genera.explanation: NABARD was established in 1982. NABARD began operations on 12 July 1982 as the apex institution for agricultural and rural-development finance.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-grade-iii-of-mj.expectedStem: Which sector contributes the highest to the Gross Domestic Product of India?
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-grade-iii-of-mj.explanation: The services sector is the largest component of India’s GDP. Services include trade, finance, transport and public services; in aggregate they exceed agriculture and manufacturing in GDP share.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-grade-iii-of-mj.expectedStem: Who is the present chairman of NITI Aayog?
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-grade-iii-of-mj.explanation: NITI Aayog’s chairperson is the Prime Minister; at the exam date this was Narendra Modi. NITI Aayog is chaired ex officio by the serving Prime Minister, who was Narendra Modi at the 2024 exam date.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-grade-iii-of-mj.expectedStem: Minimum support price (MSP) is the guaranteed amount paid to farmers based on the recommendations of
expectedOptions: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-grade-iii-of-mj.explanation: The Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices recommends MSPs to the government. CACP advises the government on crop MSPs; the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs makes the final approval decision.

mpsc-group-b-archive2325-grade-iii-of-mj.expectedStem: In which year Planning Commission was set up to help design and execute suitable policies for economic development?
mpsc-group-b-archive2325-grade-iii-of-mj.explanation: The Planning Commission was established by Cabinet resolution on 15 March 1950. The Commission was formed by executive resolution in March 1950, before the First Five Year Plan began in 1951.

mpsc-group-b-ng-january-2026-group-b-non.expectedStem: According to IMF projections for 2025, which nation recorded the highest growth rate among major economies?
mpsc-group-b-ng-january-2026-group-b-non.explanation: The cited IMF projection placed India highest among the listed major economies. For the IMF forecast vintage referred to in the 2026 paper, India’s projected growth exceeded China, Japan and South Korea among these choices.

mpsc-group-b-ng-january-2026-group-b-non.expectedStem: Human Development Index (HDI) is calculated using which three indicators?
mpsc-group-b-ng-january-2026-group-b-non.explanation: HDI uses health, education, and income dimensions. Health uses life expectancy, education uses years-of-schooling measures, and income uses GNI per capita.

mpsc-group-b-ng-november-2024-group-b-no.expectedStem: Which Five Year Plan was implemented with the slogan “Garibi Hatao”?
mpsc-group-b-ng-november-2024-group-b-no.explanation: The Fifth Plan (1974–79) gave poverty removal prominence, whereas the Second Plan emphasized heavy industry.

mpsc-group-b-ng-november-2024-group-b-no.expectedStem: Which Five Year Plan had the primary goal to establish India as self-reliant and self-generating economy?
mpsc-group-b-ng-november-2024-group-b-no.explanation: The Third Plan (1961–66) aimed for a self-reliant, self-generating economy; the First Plan prioritized agriculture and the Second industrialization.

mpsc-ldc-2025-paper-1-q008.expectedStem: The tax on import and export of commodities is known as
mpsc-ldc-2025-paper-1-q008.explanation: Customs duties are taxes imposed on goods when they cross a national border. VAT and GST tax domestic supplies or consumption, while excise duties are associated with manufacture or production.

mpsc-ldc-2025-paper-1-q043.expectedStem: Which of the following would come under capital expenditure?
mpsc-ldc-2025-paper-1-q043.explanation: Buying tools and machinery creates assets used over several years, so it is capital expenditure. Salaries, rent and routine repairs are recurring revenue expenditure.

mpsc-udc-combined-2025-paper-1-q008.expectedStem: What is the important function of taxation in India?
mpsc-udc-combined-2025-paper-1-q008.explanation: Taxation raises revenue that the government uses for public services, administration and investment. Reducing inflation or black money may be policy effects of particular taxes, but raising public funds is the basic function asked here.

mpsc-udc-combined-2025-paper-1-q010.expectedStem: What is the main purpose of buffer stock in India?
expectedOptions: To save food grains from environmental threats
To provide farmers a place to store food grains
mpsc-udc-combined-2025-paper-1-q010.explanation: A buffer stock lets public agencies buy grain when supplies are plentiful and release it when supplies are tight. This cushions food-price swings and supports availability; it is not simply rented storage for individual farmers.

mpsc-udc-combined-2025-paper-1-q011.expectedStem: Which industry is related to the second green revolution?
mpsc-udc-combined-2025-paper-1-q011.explanation: Food processing adds value to farm produce, reduces spoilage and links higher agricultural output to markets. It is the industry associated with a proposed second Green Revolution in the terminology used by this question.

mpsc-udc-combined-2025-paper-1-q012.expectedStem: Which among the following is a domestic payment system?
mpsc-udc-combined-2025-paper-1-q012.explanation: RuPay is India’s domestic card-payment network operated by NPCI. Visa, MasterCard and American Express are international card networks, so RuPay is the domestic option.

mpsc-udc-combined-2025-paper-1-q013.expectedStem: What is meant by the ‘Take off stage’ in an economy?
mpsc-udc-combined-2025-paper-1-q013.explanation: In Rostow’s stages of economic growth, take-off is the stage when investment and industrial activity accelerate enough for sustained growth. Stagnation, collapse and decline describe the opposite direction.

mpsc-udc-combined-2025-paper-1-q014.expectedStem: What is amoderate degree of controlled inflation called?
mpsc-udc-combined-2025-paper-1-q014.explanation: Reflation is deliberate policy to lift prices and activity from a depressed level toward normal conditions. Stagflation combines inflation with weak growth, hyperinflation is uncontrolled rapid price growth, and disinflation is slower inflation.

mpsc-ldc-2026apr-paper-1-q016.expectedStem: The think tank of government of India that replaced the Planning Commission is?
mpsc-ldc-2026apr-paper-1-q016.explanation: The Government of India established NITI Aayog on 1 January 2015 as the policy institution succeeding the Planning Commission. The other three names are not that institution.

mpsc-ldc-2026apr-paper-1-q028.expectedStem: What does ‘NPA’ stand for in the banking sector?
mpsc-ldc-2026apr-paper-1-q028.explanation: NPA means Non-Performing Asset. In banking, a loan becomes non-performing when repayment of principal or interest remains overdue beyond the regulatory threshold; the other expansions are not banking asset classifications.

mpsc-ldc-2026apr-paper-1-q029.expectedStem: Which of the following has the regulatory powers to prevent recurrence of scams in Indian Capital Market?
mpsc-ldc-2026apr-paper-1-q029.explanation: SEBI regulates India’s securities and capital markets, including intermediaries, disclosures and market misconduct. RBI regulates banking and monetary matters; SBI and SIDBI are financial institutions rather than the securities-market regulator.

mpsc-ldc-2026apr-paper-1-q031.expectedStem: In which year, National Food Security Act was passed?
mpsc-ldc-2026apr-paper-1-q031.explanation: Parliament enacted the National Food Security Act in 2013. It creates legal entitlements to subsidised foodgrains for eligible households, distinguishing it from the nearby years listed.

mpsc-ldc-2026apr-paper-1-q032.expectedStem: In the context of the Indian Budget, what does ‘Capital Expenditure’ primarily refer to?
expectedOptions: Money spent on salaries and pensions
Money spent on making assets like roads, bridges etc
mpsc-ldc-2026apr-paper-1-q032.explanation: Capital expenditure creates or acquires durable assets, such as roads and bridges, or reduces liabilities. Salaries, pensions, subsidies and interest payments are recurring revenue expenditure.

mpsc-ldc-2026apr-paper-1-q033.expectedStem: What was the prime target of the first five year plan of India?
mpsc-ldc-2026apr-paper-1-q033.explanation: The First Five Year Plan (1951–56) prioritized agriculture, irrigation and food production after independence. Heavy industrialization became the stronger emphasis of the Second Plan.

mpsc-ldc-2026apr-paper-1-q035.expectedStem: The Second Five Year Plan in India was based on which model?
mpsc-ldc-2026apr-paper-1-q035.explanation: The Second Five Year Plan (1956–61) followed P. C. Mahalanobis’s strategy of building heavy industry and capital-goods capacity. The Harrod–Domar model is associated with the First Plan.

mpsc-ldc-2026apr-paper-1-q036.expectedStem: The symbol of Reserve Bank of India is
expectedOptions: Kuber with a purse of money (
A dog sitting in a defensive state
mpsc-ldc-2026apr-paper-1-q036.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India emblem depicts a tiger standing before a palm tree. It is not the Ashoka emblem or a figure of Kubera.

mpsc-asst-dpar-2018-paper-2-q022.expectedStem: Which of the following Union ministry launches SAATHI to help small Industries?
expectedOptions: Ministry of Minority Affairs and Human Resource Development
Ministry of Power and Science & Technology
mpsc-asst-dpar-2018-paper-2-q022.explanation: The Ministries of Power and Textiles jointly launched SAATHI in 2017. The initiative supplied energy-efficient powerloom equipment to small textile units, so the pairing in option D matches both the sponsoring ministries and programme purpose.

mpsc-group-b-si-police-2026-p2-Q18.expectedStem: Which of the following is correct about repo rate?
expectedOptions: It is the rate at which RBI borrows funds from Commercial Banks in the country.
It is the rate at which RBI provides short term loans to scheduled commercial banks against approved securities.
Current repo rate as onFebruary 2025 is 3%
mpsc-group-b-si-police-2026-p2-Q18.explanation: The repo rate is the rate at which RBI provides short-term funds to banks against eligible securities under a repurchase agreement. Reverse repo describes RBI absorbing funds from banks, while CRR and SLR are reserve requirements.

mpsc-group-b-fr-2019-science-2-Q17.expectedStem: Who is the Father of Green Revolution in India?
mpsc-group-b-fr-2019-science-2-Q17.explanation: M. S. Swaminathan is called the father of India’s Green Revolution for leading the introduction and spread of high-yielding wheat and rice varieties in India. Norman Borlaug is associated with the global Green Revolution.

mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs2-Q.expectedStem: Who recommends Minimum Support Price and issue prices in India?
expectedOptions: Commission for Agriculture Costs and Prices
mpsc-group-b-inspector-excise-2019-gs2-Q.explanation: The Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices recommends minimum support prices to the Union government after considering production costs and market conditions. The reference to “issue prices” is loose: central issue prices under the public distribution system are set through separate government decisions.
